vessel: Gothic teal steam launch with brass trim
other_move_keys_do: Nothing: W and S have no effect on the boat.

waypoints.note: Open Gullwater, rocks to the right

legs.feel: Quiet steam chugging, rain starting, the beacon dark behind and Saint Calder's glow ahead.

waypoints.note: Leave the quays with the burner

legs.feel: Roaring storm, rocks closing in, Arthur shouting directions over the wind.

docks.note: Boat slows to a stop and ties up on entering the zone.
Boat stops at the Saltgate quays; the player lands to fetch the burner.

collision_recovery: On a hazard hit the boat bounces off and is moved to the nearest SAFE point on the route with a small cost; the burner is never lost.
tide_hook: A Vector2 'water_push' added to the boat's velocity each physics frame, zero until the Tide / Wave agent supplies it.
handling_checks: Hold A for 5 s: the boat turns at the maximum rate with no spin-out.
Release A and D: the rudder centres and the boat holds a straight line.
Press W and S: nothing happens to speed or heading.
Thread a 12 m gap between two rocks at full speed without hitting either.
Enter DOCK_PORT and DOCK_LIGHTHOUSE off-centre: docking completes automatically.
Alternate A and D quickly: no jitter in the camera or hull.
open_creator_decisions: Whether the earlier return-crossing data (6 m/s) should be regenerated at the confirmed 3 m/s.
Whether Arthur, as a passenger, moves around the boat while it is steered.
